paper.title: Maillard Sampling: Boltzmann Exploration Done Optimally

settings.definition_quote: In this paper, we focus on the assumption that $y_t - \mu_{I_t}$ is $\sig^2$-sub-Gaussian, i.e.,  $\EE[\exp(\lam \eta_t)] \le \exp(\lam^2 \sig^2/2)$, and that the algorithm knows $\sig^2$, which is standard.

source.label: thm:ms
source.quote: MS satisfies that, $\forall T\ge1$ and $c>0$, \EE\Reg_T \le \sum_{a\in[K]: \Delta_a > 0}\Bigg(\fr{2\sigma^2(1+c)^2 \ln(\fr{T\Delta_a^2}{\sigma^2} )}{\Delta_a} + O\del{\Delta_a \vee \del{\fr{(1+c)^2\sigma^2}{c^2\Delta_a}\ln\fr{(1+c)^2\sigma^2}{c^2\Delta_a^2}}}\Bigg)

results.notes: Leading term has explicit constant; only the second-order term is in O(). Implies sub-UCB and asymptotic optimality with c=1/o(ln^{1/2} T). Appendix version has ln(1+...) in second term.

source.label: thm1_cor
source.quote: MS satisfies that that, $\forall T\ge1$, \EE\Reg_T \le O(\sigma\sqrt{KT\ln(T)})~.

extra_assumptions: dependence on algorithm parameters C in [0,1], D in (0,1] omitted

source.label: thm_IMS
source.quote: \MSP (Algorithm~\ref{alg:ims}) satisfies that, for every $T\ge1$ and $c>0$, \EE \Reg_T \le \sum_{a:\Delta_a>0} \fr{2\sigma^2(1+c)^2 \ln(\fr{T\Delta_a^2}{2\sigma^2}(1+\ln(1+\fr{T\Delta_a^2}{2\sigma^2})))}{\Delta_a} + O\del{ B\fr{\sigma^2(1+c)^2\ln(1+\ln(\fr{T\Delta_a^2}{2\sigma^2}))}{c^2\Delta_a} + \Delta_a} where we omit the dependence on $C$ and $D$ for brevity.

results.notes: Leading term explicit; O() term placed inside the sum (paper's typesetting ambiguous). Booster B renamed to avoid clash with canonical budget B.

bound.regime: for all T >= 1; B, C, D absolute constants

extra_assumptions: algorithm parameters B, C, D are absolute constants

source.label: thm2_cor
source.quote: \MSP with absolute constants $B$, $C$, and $D$ satisfies that, $\forall T\ge1$, \EE \Reg_T\le O(\sigma\sqrt{KT\ln(K)})~.
